gates.acceptance: Clean normal launch, correct build/dependency identity, understandable offline and missing-config paths; no developer world seeding.
gates.remaining: Portable offline launch/build checks remain bounded; excluded launcher identity correction and native Windows launch/setup are unqualified.

gates.acceptance: Reviewed atomic creation gives real actor/location/knowledge/capabilities; unsupported starts remain limited.
gates.remaining: Reviewed R00 and quay normal creation exist; exact final compatible selection still needs independent normal-start acceptance. No unselected allowance/council is required by this criterion.

gates.acceptance: Suggestions and own responses map to exact versioned attempts, commit only on acceptance, and preserve unsupported/ambiguous intent.
gates.remaining: Versioned attempts, review and unsupported declarations exist; final compatible browser/HTTP intent and ambiguity acceptance remains required.

gates.acceptance: Selected movement/perception, work/needs/recovery, stock and commitments persist across interruption; no invented time/resources.
gates.remaining: Finite stock/work/movement and interruption persist; selected ordinary needs/recovery and provisioning-deficit replenishment remain missing in the supported contexts.

gates.acceptance: Normal-start participants/channels and real social consequences keep received testimony, offer, consent and fulfillment distinct.
gates.remaining: Received testimony, optional offers and bounded refusal/agreement are distinct; cross-context social consequences and obligation fulfillment need full ordinary-start acceptance. A fictional council proposal is not the minimum contract.

gates.acceptance: At least one NPC and local institution act on legitimate knowledge/authority/shared resources and alter later choices across continuation.
gates.remaining: Oren player-control/availability guards protect continuing decisions; a continuing local institution acting with legitimate knowledge/authority/shared resources and changing later choices remains missing.

gates.acceptance: An adopted bounded profile supports consequential success/failure/withdrawal and persistent recovery, not narrator truth writes.
gates.remaining: Failed prerequisites and a blocked route are bounded failures; an adopted risk profile with consequential success/failure/withdrawal and persistent recovery is not implemented.

gates.acceptance: One protected provider completes a budgeted live synthetic cycle; invalid output, cancellation, timeout, outage and budget exhaustion remain safe; routine calls zero.
gates.remaining: Offline/failure foundations exist; an eligible protected route and explicit finite budget for a live synthetic cycle remain absent. No paid calls authorized.

gates.acceptance: Atomic result/state, immutable original receipt, no duplication, lost-reply recovery, stale handling and restore fencing in multi-session play.
gates.remaining: Saves revision fix, exact retry/restore and real Store fault characterization are bounded evidence. Multi-session full acceptance remains open; Creator creation/recovery semantics are proposals, not atomic durability guarantees.

gates.acceptance: Two independent ordinary contexts from distinct families including non-Rise personal play; actual different constraints, evolving consequences and retained R00 regressions.
gates.remaining: Two bounded three-process journeys preserve different material constraints and consequences. Sustained depth, ordinary recovery, continuing agency and selected risk remain incomplete; strict consumer status is held.

gates.acceptance: Actual browser plus native Windows clean-package launch, responsive/keyboard controls, truthful status/time, saves and actionable errors.
gates.remaining: Linux Chromium desktop/mobile preview and Saves checks pass. Native Windows clean-package launch and its required setup/usability evidence remain unexecuted; policy denial is preserved.

gates.acceptance: One exact compatible set/pins with all mandatory gates reviewed, scoped DEV/C2 evidence, preserved archives, clean package and no blocking ordinary-play/privacy/data-loss defect.
gates.remaining: Pre-Alpha compatible-set/package qualification is distinct from Alpha. All mandatory functional criteria must qualify on one exact release set; this increment does not satisfy that condition.
